description: Nominal spin-1 nuclear quadrupoles used by the full-bath Q-on model.
source: Efimova and Hore (2009), Table 2 principal values for FAD radical anion N5/N10 and protonated Trp radical cation N1; approximate orientation in the Hiscock flavin frame.
units: field-equivalent mT; multiply by 2*pi*28 for rad/us; not the conventional quadrupole coupling constant chi
frame: Common flavin molecular xyz. x/y in the flavin plane; z is the ring normal.
tensor_construction: Subtract each triplet's mean, assign its entries to the stated hyperfine principal axes, and rotate to flavin xyz. The eigenvectors from Supplementary Table 2 were not directly imported.

FAD:N5.orientation: Qz along the lower-eigenvalue in-plane hyperfine axis (provisional azimuth), Qy along flavin z.

FAD:N10.orientation: Qz aligned with the dominant hyperfine axis, flavin z.

TrpH:N1.orientation: Qz aligned with the dominant TrpH N1 hyperfine axis, about 37 degrees from flavin z; small local tilt neglected.
